title: Zoobits — Animal Puzzle
description: Zoobits is a gentle jigsaw puzzle built around thirty short animated clips of adorable animals. Each level hands you a scrambled picture and asks you to rebuild it one square at a time. Early boards are a simple 3x3, but the grid grows to 4x4, 5x5, 6x6 and finally a demanding 7x7 as you travel from Grassland through Underground, Mountain and Sky down to the Undersea world. Some levels let you swap tiles, others spin individual squares a quarter turn, and the hardest combine both rules at once. A hint button appears whenever you stall, quietly demonstrating the next correct move so nobody gets stuck.
instructions: Tap two tiles to swap them, drag a tile onto another to swap, or tap a single tile to turn it a quarter turn. Press HINT for a guided step.
